content.title: Who got voted off 'Survivor' tonight? How to watch 'Survivor' live
content.text: April 15, 2026, 3:14 p.m. MT"Survivor 50" has gotten its first jury member.After the triple-elimination twist from the previous week, tensions were high in Fiji. The Castaways competed for a reward: Chinese takeout and brownies.The Manulevu tribe was split into two groups of seven and whoever finished the challenge first was awarded dinner and the opportunity to compete in a second challenge for individual immunity.Ozzy Lusth, Rick Devens, Christian Hubicki, Emily Flippen, Dee Valladares, LaGrossa Kendrick and Joe Hunter won the reward and Lusth won immunity.The 14-player tribal council, the largest in "Survivor" history, then had to decide who to vote for and things got messy.Dee Valladares was sent packing and became the first member of the jury by a vote of 8-4-1, with Tiffany Ervin receiving four votes and Benjamin "Coach" Wade receiving one.Here's who is left on "Survivor 50," what time "Survivor" is on tonight and who gets voted off.Who is left on 'Survivor 50'?Here's the cast of "Survivor" Season 50:Jenna Lewis-Dougherty: Seasons 1 (Borneo), 8 (All-Stars) - VOTED OFFRizo Velovic: Season 49What day is 'Survivor' on?"Survivor 50" airs Wednesdays beginning Feb. 25 until its live finale on May 20.Is 'Survivor' on tonight?Yes, a new episode of "Survivor" Season 50 is out tonight, April 15.What time does 'Survivor' come on?Season 50, Episode 8 of "Survivor" is out tonight, Wednesday, April 15, at 8 p.m. ET/PT and 7 p.m. Arizona time.How long is 'Survivor' tonight?Episode 8 of "Survivor 50" will be 90 minutes long.What channel is 'Survivor' on?You can watch "Survivor 50" on your local CBS network or channel 5 in the Valley.Where to stream 'Survivor'You can also stream "Survivor" live on Paramount+ with the Paramount+ Premium plan or the next day with Paramount+ Essential.The Paramount+ Premium plan costs $13.99 per month or $139.99 per year and Paramount+ Essential begins at $8.99 per month.Who gets voted off 'Survivor' tonight?*Spoilers ahead for the Wednesday, April 15 episode of "Survivor 50"*Benjamin "Coach" Wade has a 98% chance of going home during Season 50, Episode 8 of "Survivor," based on regulated exchange and prediction market Kalshi. Followed by Christian Hubicki at 5% and Rick Devens at 3%.Odds on Kalshi have been accurate since "Survivor 50" premiered on Feb. 24, according to northjersey.com.Do you have a tip or a question you need answered?
